text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: P0 fired for service=rate-limiter (high 429 rate) — alert_id=PD-98421. Auto-escalation engaged.

oncall-bot: Details: spike >3000 429s/min across eu-west and us-east, some customers reporting app errors. Thresholds tripped at 06:12 UTC.

alex: acked in PD, taking lead — pulling logs now. anyone oncall in eu?

priya: i’m oncall for infra, wdyt about routing a quick bypass to reduce customer impact?

alex: running quick checks. `curl -s http://rate-limiter.internal/metrics | tail -n 5` shows:
```
rate_limiter_429_total 41234
rate_limiter_requests_total 1234567
rate_limiter_active_workers 1
rate_limiter_config_version 2026-03-14_06:00
```

alex: interesting — we have only 1 active worker in the limiter pool for both regions. expected 6. looks like worker autoscale failed.

maria: confirmed on infra side — autoscaler didn't spin up due to a failing healthcheck after recent build. healthcheck failing on `/healthz` with 502. rollback of last deploy would fix.

priya: can we flip fallback policy to permissive mode for 10m while we restore workers? that will reduce 429s but could increase burst/cost.

alex: yes — runbook suggests `POST /admin/fallback?mode=permissive` on limiter admin. doing it now.

alex: ```
curl -X POST -u admin:*** https://rate-limiter.internal/admin/fallback?mode=permissive
# returned 200 OK
```

pd-bot: PagerDuty note: alex acknowledged PD-98421 and added note "temporary permissive fallback set, restoring workers".

jamie: looping in runtime team — deploying hotfix to healthcheck. @maria can you revert the last limiter image?

maria: reverting now — running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/rl-workers -n limiter --to-revision=145`. watching.

alex: after fallback, 429 rate dropped to ~80/min within 90s. customers reporting fewer errors. still watching for edge cases.

priya: what about sticky tenant mapping bug we saw in earlier incidents? any sign of quota misapplication?

alex: digging into request logs: looks like quota mapper was fine, headers show tenant-id preserved. the big driver was workers=1 + request storm from synthetic replay that hit anycasted endpoints.

maria: rollback finished — new pods spinning up, readiness also fixed. `kubectl get pods` shows 6/6 ready across both zones.

alex: verifying metrics again: 
```
rate_limiter_active_workers 6
rate_limiter_429_total 41350  # small bump, then tailing off
```

pd-bot: PagerDuty: alex marked alert PD-98421 as resolved.

priya: nice. action items: 1) investigate why autoscaler healthcheck regressed after image bump; 2) add a guard so fallback triggers automatically on worker count <2; 3) run a synthetic flood replay in staging to validate autoscale.

jamie: i'll take #1 and #2, adding to SRE queue. alex can you open an incident doc? include timeline, runbook steps, and customer impact numbers (approx 30k 429s over 8m, ~120 customers saw transient errors).

alex: creating incident doc now and will cc postmortem channel. for customer comms — Product, pls prepare a short note: we reduced error rates with temporary permissive fallback; investigating root cause and will follow up.

maria: note: the permissive fallback should auto-revert after 15m; i've set a manual check to ensure it's off once system stable.

alex: handing off final monitoring to @jamie for the 08:00 UTC rotation. leaving PD notes and runbook steps in the incident doc.

jamie: acked. thanks all. adding blameless postmortem tag. :white_check_mark:

pd-bot: PagerDuty: PD-98421 resolved by alex at 06:28 UTC.

oncall-bot: Thread closed. Please follow up in #postmortems and link incident doc: /incidents/1973123456-rate-limiter-autoscale-rollback.
